name: Imageye
summary: Finds every image on a page (including srcset variants, CSS backgrounds and inline SVGs), filters them by size/type/layout, converts formats and bulk-downloads them individually or as a ZIP.
price: Free (store listing shows no paid tier; imageye.net markets an optional Pro)
browsersNote: No Firefox listing found on the check date.
license: Proprietary; no open-source license stated on the store page.
goodFor: Finding, filtering and bulk-downloading every image on a page.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: image downloader extractor srcset css background svg bulk zip
